comparison.objective: Position microphones according to the 3:1 spacing rule; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-584 tests stand transport, handoff, and relational spatial placement; candidate tests hex-key insertion, counterholding, fine rotation, and trial-based adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: PR-584 requires each stand within 6 cm and pairwise 3:1 separation; candidate requires two safe impact cycles and a retained lock. No spec versions exist.
comparison.reason: The tasks test different abilities beyond generic bimanual handling.
